assignment_end_reason.name: assignment_end_reason
assignment_end_reason.value: ("electoral"."organizational_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_assignments"."ended_reason" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."organizational_assignments"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("electoral"."organizational_assignments"."ended_reason")) BETWEEN 3 AND 500)

center_area_end.name: center_area_end
center_area_end.value: ("electoral"."center_area_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "electoral"."center_area_assignments"."ended_reason" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."center_area_assignments"."ended_at" >= "electoral"."center_area_assignments"."started_at" AND length(trim("electoral"."center_area_assignments"."ended_reason")) BETWEEN 3 AND 500)

center_official_evidence.name: center_official_evidence
center_official_evidence.value: "electoral"."center_elections"."official_status" = 'sin_verificar' OR ("electoral"."center_elections"."data_source" = 'oficial' AND "electoral"."center_elections"."source_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."center_elections"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

fiscal_board_current_role.name: fiscal_board_current_role
fiscal_board_current_role.where: "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."board_id" IS NOT NULL

fiscal_board_current_person.name: fiscal_board_current_person
fiscal_board_current_person.where: "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."board_id" IS NOT NULL

fiscal_role_destination.name: fiscal_role_destination
fiscal_role_destination.value: ("electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."role" IN ('general','general_suplente') AND "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."board_id" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."role" IN ('titular','suplente') AND "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."board_id" IS NOT NULL)

fiscal_end_valid.name: fiscal_end_valid
fiscal_end_valid.value: ("electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."ended_reason" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."ended_at">="electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."started_at" AND length(trim("electoral"."fiscal_assignments"."ended_reason")) BETWEEN 3 AND 500)

inventory_item_text.name: inventory_item_text
inventory_item_text.value: length(trim("electoral"."inventory_items"."name")) between 2 and 120 and length("electoral"."inventory_items"."variant") <= 100 and length(trim("electoral"."inventory_items"."category")) between 2 and 80 and "electoral"."inventory_items"."unit" in ('pieza','caja','paquete','docena','metro','litro','kilogramo') and "electoral"."inventory_items"."version" > 0

inventory_location_kind.name: inventory_location_kind
inventory_location_kind.value: length(trim("electoral"."inventory_locations"."name")) between 2 and 160 and (("electoral"."inventory_locations"."kind"='almacen' and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."district_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."center_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."person_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."event_id" is null) or ("electoral"."inventory_locations"."kind"='distrito' and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."district_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."center_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."person_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."event_id" is null) or ("electoral"."inventory_locations"."kind"='centro' and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."center_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."event_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."district_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."person_id" is null) or ("electoral"."inventory_locations"."kind"='persona' and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."person_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."district_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."center_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_locations"."event_id" is null))

inventory_movement_data.name: inventory_movement_data
inventory_movement_data.value: "electoral"."inventory_movements"."quantity" > 0 and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."quantity" <> 'NaN'::numeric and length(trim("electoral"."inventory_movements"."reason")) between 3 and 500 and length("electoral"."inventory_movements"."evidence") <= 500 and length("electoral"."inventory_movements"."origin") <= 160 and ("electoral"."inventory_movements"."kind"<>'ingreso' or length(trim("electoral"."inventory_movements"."origin")) >= 2) and (("electoral"."inventory_movements"."kind"='ingreso' and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."source_id" is null and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."destination_id" is not null) or ("electoral"."inventory_movements"."kind"='transferencia' and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."source_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."destination_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."source_id"<>"electoral"."inventory_movements"."destination_id") or ("electoral"."inventory_movements"."kind" in ('consumo','dano','perdida','robo','baja') and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."source_id" is not null and "electoral"."inventory_movements"."destination_id" is null))

inventory_receipt_valid.name: inventory_receipt_valid
inventory_receipt_valid.value: "electoral"."inventory_receipts"."byte_size">0 AND "electoral"."inventory_receipts"."byte_size"<=5242880 AND "electoral"."inventory_receipts"."mime_type" IN ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png') AND length("electoral"."inventory_receipts"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND "electoral"."inventory_receipts"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

position_scope.name: position_scope
position_scope.value: ("electoral"."organizational_positions"."kind" = 'general' AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."district_id" IS NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."functional_area_id" IS NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."sectoral_movement_id" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."organizational_positions"."kind" IN ('district', 'district_substitute') AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."district_id" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."functional_area_id" IS NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."sectoral_movement_id" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."organizational_positions"."kind" = 'area' AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."district_id" IS NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."functional_area_id" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."sectoral_movement_id" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."organizational_positions"."kind" = 'area_link' AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."district_id" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."functional_area_id" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."sectoral_movement_id" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."organizational_positions"."kind" IN ('movement', 'movement_link') AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."functional_area_id" IS NULL AND "electoral"."organizational_positions"."sectoral_movement_id" IS NOT NULL)

transport_request_kind.name: transport_request_kind
transport_request_kind.value: "electoral"."transport_requests"."kind" in ('driver','passenger') and ("electoral"."transport_requests"."kind"<>'driver' or (length(trim("electoral"."transport_requests"."name")) between 2 and 160 and "electoral"."transport_requests"."contact"<>''))

transport_request_text.name: transport_request_text
transport_request_text.value: length("electoral"."transport_requests"."name")<=160 and length("electoral"."transport_requests"."contact")<=254 and length("electoral"."transport_requests"."vehicle_details")<=160 and length("electoral"."transport_requests"."review_reason")<=500 and "electoral"."transport_requests"."payload_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "electoral"."transport_requests"."version">0 and ("electoral"."transport_requests"."desired_time"='' or "electoral"."transport_requests"."desired_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

transport_trip_valid.name: transport_trip_valid
transport_trip_valid.value: "electoral"."transport_service_trips"."ends_at">"electoral"."transport_service_trips"."starts_at" and length(trim("electoral"."transport_service_trips"."title")) between 2 and 160 and length(trim("electoral"."transport_service_trips"."meeting_point")) between 2 and 300 and length("electoral"."transport_service_trips"."institutional_contact")<=254 and length("electoral"."transport_service_trips"."cancel_reason")<=500 and "electoral"."transport_service_trips"."version">0 and (not "electoral"."transport_service_trips"."published" or ("electoral"."transport_service_trips"."confirmed" and "electoral"."transport_service_trips"."canceled_at" is null and length(trim("electoral"."transport_service_trips"."institutional_contact"))>=3))

center_coordinates.name: center_coordinates
center_coordinates.value: ("electoral"."voting_centers"."latitude" IS NULL AND "electoral"."voting_centers"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("electoral"."voting_centers"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."voting_centers"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "electoral"."voting_centers"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "electoral"."voting_centers"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
